newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSAPANK AT 60 PCT OF YR PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: HANSAPANK AT 60 PCT OF YR PROFIT.

text.p: Leading Estonian bank Hansapank said on Tuesday its profit so far this year was 224.4 million kroons, which was 59.1 percent of the forecast 1997 total.
It reported net income for July of 37 million kroons, the first bank to report on its activities for last month.
The bank also said its assets rose a record 1.42 billion kroons in July to 9.04 billion kroons.
"To a large extent the growth was contributed by short-term time deposits of some of our larger clients," the bank said in a statement.

Deposits last month rose by a record 1.32 billion kroons to 5.69 billion kroons. Demand deposits rose 6.9 percent to 3.41 billion kroons and time deposits were up 1.10 billion kroons to 2.28 billion kroons.
